title: InfoScan fails to properly handle certain malformed or incomplete requests to its login and… (CVE-2026-120298)
description: InfoScan has a vulnerability in its login and password-reset endpoints where malformed or incomplete requests cause unhandled server exceptions. These exceptions reveal detailed Node.js stack traces, including internal filesystem paths, directory names, source file locations, and line numbers. This information disclosure can aid attackers in understanding the internal structure of the application.
